subtitle: The Fear & Greed index measures crypto sentiment on a 0-100 scale. Extreme Fear (under 25) is historically the BEST buying opportunity. Extreme Greed (over 75) is historically the WORST time to buy. The simplest contrarian indicator in crypto.

blocks.content:
'Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful.' That single Warren Buffett quote captures the entire crypto Fear & Greed framework. The math of mean reversion at sentiment extremes works in any market — crypto's index just makes it measurable.

The crypto Fear & Greed Index publishes daily and gives a single number 0-100 capturing aggregate sentiment. Extremes are contrarian signals. The middle is just neutral.

Fear & Greed (provided by alternative.me) combines several inputs into one score:

  • Volatility (25%): current vs average. Higher volatility = fear.
  • Market momentum (25%): current vs 30/90 day averages. Lower momentum = fear.
  • Social media (15%): Reddit/Twitter sentiment analysis.
  • Surveys (15%): weekly user surveys.
  • Dominance (10%): BTC dominance moves. Sudden BTC dominance rises = fear.
  • Trends (10%): Google search trends for crypto-related terms.

The aggregate produces a number that's reasonably representative of where retail sentiment sits. It's not perfect but it's a quick read.

blocks.title: The contrarian principle
blocks.content:
At the EXTREMES, the index works as a contrarian indicator because:

  • Extreme Fear = everyone who wanted to sell, sold. No more sellers = no downward pressure left.
  • Extreme Greed = everyone who wanted to buy, bought. No more buyers = no upward pressure left.

Mean reversion is the structural response to these extremes. Combined with technical signals (S/R level + reversal pattern + volume), Fear & Greed extremes mark some of the best contrarian trade setups available.

Most useful action thresholds:

  • F&G below 25 (Extreme Fear): bias LONG. Look for technical bottoming patterns + key support + bullish reversal candle + volume. The most lucrative buy zones in crypto history have been at F&G 10-20 with confirming chart signals.
  • F&G above 75 (Extreme Greed): bias SHORT or take profits. Look for technical topping patterns + key resistance + bearish reversal candle + volume. The worst times to add longs have historically been at F&G 80-100.
  • F&G 25-75: no strong contrarian signal. Trade your technicals normally.

blocks.title: Don't trade Fear & Greed alone
blocks.content:
Same rule as every other indicator — standalone signals are weaker than confluence. F&G at 18 means 'set up to look for longs', not 'long immediately'. You still need technical confirmation: support level + reversal candle + volume.

F&G can stay at 15-20 for weeks during prolonged bear markets. Buying just because the index is low has produced many losing trades. Buying when F&G is at extreme + technicals confirm = much higher probability.

F&G has historical patterns within crypto cycles:

  • Bear market lows: F&G typically hits 5-15 (Extreme Fear). Often persists for weeks or months during deep bears.
  • Early bull market: F&G grinding higher from fear into neutral.
  • Mid bull market: F&G regularly hitting 60-80.
  • Late bull / blow-off top: F&G sustained at 80-95 (Extreme Greed). This is often within weeks of major tops.
  • Cycle top: F&G can flash to 95+ briefly, then drop precipitously as the trend reverses.
  • Bear market beginning: F&G dropping from 80+ to 30-40 within a few weeks.

Recognizing where you are in the cycle (via F&G + price action) tells you whether you're in 'bias long, expect dips to buy' (early/mid bull) or 'bias take profits' (late bull) or 'patience and wait for bottoming' (bear).

blocks.content:
1. Buying every Fear print without technical confirmation. F&G can stay low for months during bears. Wait for confirmed bottoming pattern + level + volume.
  2. Selling every Greed print blindly. Same issue mirror. Bull markets can sustain high F&G for weeks.
  3. Ignoring F&G entirely. Even though it's not a precision timing tool, the extremes are real contrarian markers. Worth a 10-second check before any major position.
  4. Trusting F&G for INTRADAY signals. The index updates daily. Use it for swing/positional context, not for 5-minute timing.
  5. Trading against F&G during macro extremes. F&G 95 during clear bull euphoria + you decide to long because 'this time is different' = trying to fight history.

Scenario: BTC has been crashing for 2 months. Down from $75K to $45K. The current 4H candle prints at $44,200 — a previous swing low + round number + 200-week MA confluence. Bullish engulfing pattern + 3× average volume + RSI bullish divergence on 4H.

F&G check: index at 16 (Extreme Fear).

Signal stack:

  • Major HTF support ✓
  • Bullish reversal candle ✓
  • Above-average volume ✓
  • RSI bullish divergence ✓
  • F&G Extreme Fear (16) — contrarian buy signal ✓

This is the A+ contrarian long setup. Multiple confluences across different lenses (technical + sentiment + structure). Trade:

  • Entry: Limit BUY at $44,500
  • SL: $42,500 (below the swing low + buffer)
  • TP1: $50,000 (round number + structural resistance)
  • TP2: $55,000 (next major level)
  • TP3: hold for full reversal back toward $60K if structure continues

Without F&G at extreme, the same technical setup is still good but the contrarian sentiment confirmation adds significant probability boost. F&G at neutral 50 with the same chart setup = standard quality trade. F&G at 88 with the same chart setup = warning that the bounce might be brief because broader sentiment isn't supportive.

blocks.title: Take this with you
blocks.content:
Three rules:

  1. F&G < 25 = look for LONG setups. Combine with technical confirmation.
  2. F&G > 75 = look for SHORT setups OR take profits. Don't add longs at extreme greed.
  3. F&G alone is not a timing tool. It can stay at extremes for weeks. Need technical confirmation for entries.
